scenarios.title: A｜忘记拿东西
scenarios.setting: 玩家离开安检区后突然发现

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think I left something at the security checkpoint.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think I left something at the security checkpoint.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I think I forgot to pick up one of my belongings after security.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I forgot to pick up one of my belongings after security.
feedback.explanation: “I forgot to”表示忘记做某件事，后面用动词原形。

choices.text: I may have left my phone in one of the trays.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have left my phone in one of the trays.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: I just realized I left my jacket at security.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just realized I left my jacket at security.
feedback.explanation: “I left my”谈随身物品时可表示遗落；接地点能说明东西可能在哪里。

choices.text: I forgot something in the security.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think I left something at the security checkpoint.
feedback.explanation: 安检处用“security checkpoint”；已知遗落地点时，“left something at …”更准确。

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: A black phone with a clear case.

feedback.naturalExpression: A black phone with a clear case.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: My laptop. It’s a silver one.

feedback.naturalExpression: My laptop. It’s a silver one.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: A dark blue jacket. I think it was in one of the trays.

feedback.naturalExpression: A dark blue jacket. I think it was in one of the trays.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: My wallet. I may have left it near the scanner.

feedback.naturalExpression: My wallet. I may have left it near the scanner.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

turns.prompt: 你想补充地点或对象信息，方便对方确认，会怎么说？

choices.text: The one near gates 20 to 30.

feedback.naturalExpression: The one near gates 20 to 30.
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: I think it was checkpoint B.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it was checkpoint B.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’m not sure, but I came through about ten minutes ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure, but I came through about ten minutes ago.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: It was the security line closest to this gate area.

feedback.naturalExpression: It was the security line closest to this gate area.
feedback.explanation: “closest to”表示离某处最近，可用已有地标定位具体地点。

turns.prompt: 你想请工作人员查询安检处是否发现遗失物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. Could you check whether it was found?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could you check whether it was found?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I really appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

scenarios.title: B｜返回寻找
scenarios.setting: 在“安检后遗落物品”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“返回寻找”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I came through here a few minutes ago and I think I left my laptop behind.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I came through here a few minutes ago and I think I left my laptop behind.
feedback.explanation: “I left my”谈随身物品时可表示遗落；接地点能说明东西可能在哪里。

choices.text: I think I left something in one of the trays. Could I check?

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left something in one of the trays. Could I check?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I was just here, and I may have forgotten my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was just here, and I may have forgotten my phone.
feedback.explanation: “may have forgotten”表达对过去情况的推测，避免把尚未确定的遗失地点说死。

choices.text: Could I go back and look for something I left?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I go back and look for something I left?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.text: You can’t walk back into the screening area by yourself, but I can help you look.

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. It’s a silver laptop in a black sleeve.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. It’s a silver laptop in a black sleeve.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: Thank you. I think it was in the last tray I used.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I think it was in the last tray I used.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Could you check near the end of the conveyor belt?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check near the end of the conveyor belt?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I may have left it beside my backpack.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have left it beside my backpack.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

turns.text: We have a laptop here. Could you describe it?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a silver laptop with a small sticker on the back.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a silver laptop with a small sticker on the back.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: The case is black, and my name is written inside.

feedback.naturalExpression: The case is black, and my name is written inside.
feedback.explanation: “my name is”在登记时直接报出姓名，方便对方查找记录。

choices.text: There’s a scratch near the bottom-left corner.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a scratch near the bottom-left corner.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

turns.text: That matches the one we found.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s mine. Thank you so much.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s mine. Thank you so much.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. Do you need to see my boarding pass or ID?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do you need to see my boarding pass or ID?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Thank you. I’m really glad you found it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’m really glad you found it.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜向工作人员求助
scenarios.setting: 在“安检后遗落物品”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“向工作人员求助”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, who should I speak to about a lost item?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, who should I speak to about a lost item?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Is there a lost and found for the security area?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a lost and found for the security area?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could you tell me where to report something I lost at security?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me where to report something I lost at security?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I lost something after the security check. Where should I go?

feedback.naturalExpression: I lost something after the security check. Where should I go?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Where can I ask my lost thing?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, who should I speak to about a lost item?
feedback.explanation: 寻求协助用“ask about a lost item”或“speak to someone about …”，不能直接“ask my lost thing”。

turns.text: Items left at security are handled by the security lost-and-found desk.

turns.prompt: 你想确认位置或前往的路线，会怎么问？

choices.text: Where is that desk?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where is that desk?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: Is it before or after security?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it before or after security?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

choices.text: Do I need to leave this area to get there?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to leave this area to get there?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Can I report the item by phone instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I report the item by phone instead?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: It’s near checkpoint C, just past the information desk.

turns.prompt: 你想了解寻找遗失物品时需要提供什么信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: What information will they need from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: What information will they need from me?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Should I bring my boarding pass?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I bring my boarding pass?
feedback.explanation: “boarding pass”指登机牌，区别于预订记录或付款凭证。

choices.text: Do I need to describe exactly where I lost it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to describe exactly where I lost it?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Can they contact me if it’s found later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can they contact me if it’s found later?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

turns.text: Bring your ID or boarding pass and give them a description of the item.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll go there now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll go there now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
